evidence.production_rendering: The same acceptance course renders as ten lectures in overview, teaching-plan navigation and teaching calendar; lesson previews use teacher asset/state information.
evidence.teaching_ai: Created a real teaching-plan draft, POSTed an AI candidate with HTTP 200, displayed field-level diffs, then rejected and discarded the disposable draft.
evidence.ppt: A teacher-confirmed source opened the unchanged PPT workspace before student release; no fake learner publication was created.
evidence.ppt_status: After reload the production tab and PPT header read the same ready representation as generated/confirmed.
evidence.calendar_exchange: Revision 14 exported editable DOCX, searchable fixed PDF, XLSX and CSV from one calendar source. DOCX had 10 columns and ten session rows plus notes; the rendered PDF showed the same ten records without clipping.
evidence.calendar_persistence: Edited a course session, saved and reloaded it, observed the same value in the total calendar, and restored the original fixture value.
evidence.total_calendar: Month, week and list views aggregate four courses with stable colors, incomplete filtering and overlap conflicts; event actions return to the unique ClassSession or exact preparation context.
evidence.responsive: Production and calendar surfaces were inspected at 1440, 1180, 1024, 880 and 680 px. At 880 the hidden AI dock no longer reserves an empty grid column; the teaching body uses all remaining width.
